alphas-regret-marked-by-the-lycan-king:
Three years into her marriage, Estelle discovered that the bond she had treasured was nothing more than an illusion. The mark on her neck, the symbol she believed tied her to her mate, didn’t belong to him at all. Determined to confront Asher Daniels, she instead overheard a truth that shattered everything: the man who had shared her bed and whispered vows of love had found his true fated mate five years ago.
She had never been his choice—only his convenience. The child she had raised with devotion was not adopted, but his son with another woman. Even her past was a lie. She wasn’t a powerless orphan, but the lost daughter of an Alpha, the rightful heir to a pack that now had no leader.
Disgusted and resolute, Estelle made her decision without hesitation.
“I have no mate and no children. I am the sole heir to the Blackmoon Pack.”
With that, she vanished without a trace.
Asher, certain she was nothing without him—a wolfless woman with no status or power—waited for the day she would come crawling back. He never imagined the moment he would see her again.
At the Lycan royals’ mating ball, she stood transformed—radiant, untouchable, and powerful beyond recognition.…

A heavy male body lay beside me---we were both naked except for the sheet covering our bodies.
I searched my memories of the night before, trying to figure out how I had gotten here while attempting to wrap the sheet around my body. I stopped when I realized I'd leave my bed partner totally nude.
I remembered myself saying over and over, “I'm your mate!”
I eased myself off the bed to look for clothes. I tried to be as quiet as I could so I didn't wake up the stranger.

the-lowest-royal-returns:
Raelis Varekan was born into royalty but treated like trash. With 0% bloodline purity, he was branded a failure, framed for treason, and executed without a second thought.
But despite his expectations, he had come back to the time he was twelve years old, standing in front of the same bloodline testing orb. But this time, something changed.
His former 0% bloodline purity was gone, replaced by a 1% result.

[+1% Bloodline Purity]

Raelis would rise through the ranks and become the one who rewrites the Varekan Empire’s history.

to-ruin-an-omega:
On her half-sister's wedding day, Fia's world shatters. Hazel, the bride, has allegedly eloped with Fia's fated mate, and over the phone he rejects her without mercy. With the Alpha groom ready to unleash war on her pack, and spurred on by her stepmother's pleas, Fia makes a desperate choice; she takes Hazel's place at the altar.

What neither of them expects is that hate can twist, burn, and evolve into something far more dangerous. Between lies, betrayal, and a growing bond neither wants to acknowledge, Fia and Cian are bound to discover that the thin line between hate and love is meant to be crossed.

Armed with his previous cultivation experience and a fresh start in a fourteen-year-old body, the prime age of physical development, he's ready to redo his martial arts cultivation from scratch and perfect it this time. Unfortunately, Wu Yuan's initial plans for peaceful cultivation are shattered by the harsh reality of a relentless, ruthless world. Assassination attempts and conspiracies hound him, compelling him to lay low. With unwavering determination, he embarks on a thrilling journey, knowing the only true path to safety for both him and his family lies at the pinnacle of power.
